response.justification: Bogdan has over 12 years of diverse full-stack experience with strong alignment to the required stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, Docker) and deep exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, cloud platforms (AWS), testing (Vitest/Jest equivalents), and architecture — plus notable open-source contributions and process advocacy. His lack of explicit Nest.js or Kotlin/Java project mentions is mitigated by proven adaptability and breadth across similar ecosystems.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Docker across multiple enterprises
Proven AI-agent infrastructure work and open-source contributions (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Strong testing, CI/CD, and architectural advocacy with TDD, CI, and infrastructure automation
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Kotlin/Java in recent roles, though DLang/Java experience suggests adaptability
German language proficiency is only basic, potentially limiting collaboration in Berlin-based teams
Resume lacks clear metrics on scalability, performance gains, or team leadership impact

key_factors.factor: Lack of explicit Nest.js or Kotlin/Java exposure
